scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the same-evening dew-controller calibration bench run before the console clears its live hold.
Emerging Need: The controller has been checked in and the calibration attempt has begun, but the bench stops because it cannot energize the straps without the owner’s channel-map and fuse details.
Decision Context: Before plug-in the bench disallows pre-entry; after the stop, a short hold and existing notes determine whether a low-commitment update can unblock the technician.
Consequence: If the details are unavailable during the hold, the console clears the device and tonight’s calibration attempt ends unfinished.

parameter.title: Dew-controller calibration bench
parameter.description: Bring the personal dew-controller box for a short Sonoran Nightwatchers bench calibration run.

parameter.subject: Tonight's dew-controller calibration bench
parameter.body: The dew-controller bench is open tonight for confirmed drop-ins only. The console creates a device profile only after the controller is plugged in, so channel details cannot be pre-entered. Any stopped profile is held for ten minutes before the station clears it for the next device.

parameter.description: QR check-in draft for Miriam's dew-controller calibration bench station; draft appears after controller intake and does not complete payment until station finish.

parameter.content: Bench status for your MV-dew controller: the live calibration profile started at 19:04 but is paused. The station will not energize the straps until the tech enters the owner's channel map and fuse rating. Hold clears at 19:16.

parameter.subject: MV-dew calibration hold cleared
parameter.body: The paused profile for QR DEW-BENCH-MV-QR cleared at 19:16 after the channel-map and fuse fields remained blank. The bench queue is closed for additional dew-controller runs tonight.
